enabled.description: Enable or disable the igmpproxy service at boot.

logfile.description: Path to log file. Leave empty to log to stderr (systemd: stdout).

upstream.description: Name of the upstream network interface (connected to the multicast source).

downstream.description: List of downstream (client-facing) interfaces and their associated subnets and roles. Each item must define 'interface', 'role', 'subnet', and optionally 'allowed_groups'. 'excluded_groups' have no direct igmpproxy.conf equivalent and are ignored in the rendered config (must be handled externally).

items.description: Downstream interface configuration block. Not a list-item schema wrapper in the rendered config; instead used only as a data model for Jinja generation.

interface.description: Name of the downstream network interface.

role.description: Role of the interface: upstream, downstream or disabled. Must be 'downstream' for items in this list.

subnet.description: CIDR-formatted subnet served by this interface (used only for documentation in this template, actual igmpproxy.conf does not embed subnets).

allowed_groups.description: List of specific multicast groups (e.g., 239.1.1.1) allowed for forwarding on this interface. Each group is rendered as a whitelist directive for downstream interfaces. Leave empty to allow all (no whitelist entry).

excluded_groups.description: List of multicast groups explicitly excluded from forwarding. This has no direct equivalent in igmpproxy.conf syntax and is not rendered; must be handled via external firewalling or alternative igmpproxy configuration strategies.

query_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between IGMP queries from upstream interface.

threshold.description: TTL threshold for downstream interfaces (default per igmpproxy.conf is 1; this setting maps to the threshold TTL in the phyint directive).

quickleave.description: Enable quickleave mode to reduce multicast latency when clients leave groups.
